title: Classic British Leek Gratin
description: A comforting side dish that combines the sweetness of leeks with the creaminess of cheese, all in a crispy, golden-brown gratin. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Leeks
ingredients.notes: Chopped, white and light green parts only

instructions: In a large saucepan, sauté the chopped leeks in butter until softened.
Add the flour and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the leek mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle the grated cheese evenly over the top.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
